title: Energy Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: Migrate the 🔋️energy plugin from its old layout (single crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🔋️energy/🔨️modules/⚙️engine/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/, package semio-s-plugin-energy-engine, 11,663-line lib.rs) to the new single-crate taxonomy layout at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🔋️energy/📦️packages/🦀️rust/, per the repo-wide crate-consolidation-and-plugin-taxonomy-restructure initiative. This is a regional decomposition (not a union merge, since energy is already a single crate) following the TEMPLATE recipe and writer plugin example. Ends with a registrar-handoff block; does not touch root Cargo.toml or other plugins.
summary:
Migrated 🔋️energy from its old single-crate bundle (✏️s/🔌️plugins/🔋️energy/🔨️modules/⚙️engine/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust, package semio-s-plugin-energy-engine, 11,663-line lib.rs) to the new taxonomy layout at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🔋️energy/📦️packages/🦀️rust (package renamed semio-s-plugin-energy, component id "semio:energy").

Shape finding: energy is NOT a play-app plugin — it is a pure headless BEM (building energy model) compute library with no document/projection, no Command/DSL/pack/protocol wire codec, and no UI. semio_plugin! (which requires ≥1 registered app) does not apply, so 📦️lib.rs is wiring-only mod/#[path] declarations with no macro invocation, and no 🗿️artifacts/🎛️apps directories were created (both are genuinely absent, not skipped for convenience — confirmed no Command/DSL/pack/protocol/App::builder/DocumentApp anywhere in the source). This keeps `validateTaxonomyTree` clean since its artifact/window checks are no-ops when those dirs don't exist.

Regional decomposition: the file's own 50 top-level `mod <domain> { ... }` blocks (air_exchange, air_system, airflow_network, calendar, coils, comfort, controls, curves, daylight, dispatch, economics, electrical, envelope, error, evaporative, fans, faults, fenestration, gains, geometry, heat_recovery, humidity_eq, hvac_topo, iaq, ideal_hvac, kernel, material, meters, metrics, model, num, output, plant, precompute, props, refrigeration, results, room_air, schedule, shw, sim, site, sizing, solar, solar_thermal, terminal, units, water, zone_air, zone_hvac) were the natural component boundaries (no //#region markers at that grain, but the mod blocks themselves are exactly it) — each became its own file under ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🔋️energy/⚙️engine/🦀️<domain>.rs via a brace-matching Python splitter (ticket-local script, string/comment-aware, no manual editing of 11k+ lines). Declared flat at crate root in 📦️lib.rs (not nested under an artifact/app wrapper) so every internal `crate::props::…`/`crate::units::…` reference kept working unchanged with zero content rewrites. The old lib.rs's trailing flat `pub use <domain>::*;` re-export block (including the curated non-glob `ideal_hvac` re-export) was preserved verbatim in 📦️lib.rs so the crate's public flat API surface (`semio_s_plugin_energy::<Type>`) is unchanged for future Rust consumers.

Cargo.toml: package renamed semio-s-plugin-energy-engine → semio-s-plugin-energy (dropped the -engine suffix per the initiative's canonical-id convention, derived directly from the old package name + sibling plugins' semio-s-plugin-<id> pattern, not guessed). Added fresh (no prior [package.metadata.semio] table existed) [package.metadata.component] package = "semio:energy" — required by the registry's parsePluginCargo, which throws if this key is missing on any role="plugin" crate, so this key had to be added even though the old bundle crate never had one — plus [package.metadata.semio] role = "plugin" per instructions. mathematical_algebra dependency kept as an explicit path+package alias (NOT workspace=true) per TEMPLATE §3/§13's explicit warning against combining a renamed local key with workspace inheritance (verified live: cargo hard-errors "dependency.mathematical_algebra was not found in workspace.dependencies" when attempted). serde converted to `{ workspace = true }` (key matches root [workspace.dependencies] verbatim). Dropped the old dev-dependency on serde_json entirely — grepped 0 real usages in the 11,663-line source, it was dead weight.

Verified in isolation via the TEMPLATE's temporary [workspace] overlay trick (added, used, then deleted before handoff along with the nested target/ and Cargo.lock): cargo check clean, cargo check --target wasm32-wasip2 clean, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean (zero findings), cargo test 235/235 passing (exact match to the old crate's baseline — same test count, same names, all green; no test was gained or lost by the relocation), cargo build --target wasm32-wasip2 clean. Wire-proof: n/a — genuinely no DSL/pack/protocol encode/decode surface exists anywhere in this crate (confirmed by grep), so there is nothing to byte-diff; this is not a skipped step, it's a structurally absent one. Ran a ticket-local copy of the registry's validateTaxonomyTree (adapted from the cad ticket's copy) against the new tree: clean, no findings (lib.rs #[path] cross-check passes for all 50 declared components, no dangling declarations, no stray 📡️protocol segment).

Old crate deleted (✏️s/🔌️plugins/🔋️energy/🔨️modules/ removed entirely) only after the new crate was fully green. No cross-plugin Cargo dependents found (grep for semio-s-plugin-energy-engine and energy_engine across every Cargo.toml and .rs file in the repo turned up nothing outside the plugin's own old manifest). One cross-cutting TEST-ONLY dependent found OUTSIDE the plugin dir, intentionally left unedited per this session's "stay strictly inside ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🔋️energy/**" boundary: 🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/📚️library/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/🧪️index.test.ts line 1101 asserts resolveCargoPackageName("energy_engine", join(root, "✏️s/🔌️plugins/🔋️energy/🔨️modules/⚙️engine/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust")) === "semio-s-plugin-energy-engine" — this reads the now-deleted Cargo.toml off disk and will fail until updated to the new path/package name; flagged for the registrar/orchestrator, not fixed here.

Open design question for the orchestrator: [lib] intentionally has no explicit crate-type (defaults to rlib only, matching the old manifest) rather than the sibling convention of ["cdylib", "rlib"], because this crate implements no semio_plugin!/plugin_exports! guest interface — it would produce a component-shaped wasm artifact that exports nothing. Whether energy should eventually gain a minimal app surface to participate in the real playground wasm pipeline (framework-os-dev:plugin -- energy), or whether "plugin" role is even the right classification for a document-free compute library, is a judgment call left for the registrar/next wave — flagged explicitly rather than guessed.

Files created: ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🔋️energy/📦️lib.rs; ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🔋️energy/⚙️engine/🦀️{air_exchange,air_system,airflow_network,calendar,coils,comfort,controls,curves,daylight,dispatch,economics,electrical,envelope,error,evaporative,fans,faults,fenestration,gains,geometry,heat_recovery,humidity_eq,hvac_topo,iaq,ideal_hvac,kernel,material,meters,metrics,model,num,output,plant,precompute,props,refrigeration,results,room_air,schedule,shw,sim,site,sizing,solar,solar_thermal,terminal,units,water,zone_air,zone_hvac}.rs (50 files); ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🔋️energy/📦️packages/🦀️rust/{Cargo.toml,📋️project.json,📜️script.ts}. Files deleted: ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🔋️energy/🔨️modules/⚙️engine/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/{Cargo.toml,📋️project.json,📜️script.ts,📦️lib.rs} (and the now-empty 🔨️modules/ tree). Ticket-local scratch (kept, not deleted): split_engine.py, 🔍️taxonomy-audit.ts.
